noun_definition: web refers to the online platform accessed through a browser where users can engage in chat conversations and perform actions such as sending and deleting messages.
Chat refers to a conversation interface within the web application where users can send and manage messages.
Message refers to a piece of text sent in a chat conversation that the user attempts to delete using the context menu.
Context menu refers to the interactive menu that appears upon right-clicking in the chat interface, providing options such as deleting a message.
